rules.text: Apply this recommendation only when ALL requirements hold: The answer must be YES: Is the rescuer without formal water rescue training operating in hazardous water conditions (eg, beyond ability to safely enter the water)? AND The answer must be YES: Is the drowning patient within reach, or can a rope/floating object/boat/canoe/paddleboard be used from a safe location?. Recommendation: Attempt rescue from a safe location by reaching with an object, throwing a rope or floating object, or rowing to the drowning patient without entering hazardous conditions.

Apply this recommendation only when ALL requirements hold: The answer must be YES: Is the rescuer without formal water rescue training operating in hazardous water conditions (eg, beyond ability to safely enter the water)? AND The answer must be NO: Is the drowning patient within reach, or can a rope/floating object/boat/canoe/paddleboard be used from a safe location?. Recommendation: Do not enter hazardous water to attempt rescue; await or summon trained rescue personnel if available.

Apply this recommendation only when ALL requirements hold: The answer must be NO: Is the rescuer without formal water rescue training operating in hazardous water conditions (eg, beyond ability to safely enter the water)? AND The answer must be YES: Does the rescuer have formal water rescue training and appropriate personal protective/safety equipment for in-water rescue?. Recommendation: Perform in-water rescue according to level of training, expertise, equipment, and comfort level.

AND The answer must be NO: Does the rescuer have formal water rescue training and appropriate personal protective/safety equipment for in-water rescue?. Recommendation: Avoid entering the water for rescue; attempt reach/throw/row strategies from a safe location if possible.
